text: Bevor du den Router anschließt, prüfe bitte, ob das mitgelieferte Netzteil die richtige Spannung hat. Stecke zuerst das LAN-Kabel in den WAN-Port und danach in das Modem. Warte etwa zwei Minuten, bis die Status-LED dauerhaft grün leuchtet.

Melde dich mit deinem alten Passwort an und öffne die Kontoeinstellungen. Klicke auf „Passwort ändern“ und gib zweimal das neue Passwort ein. Danach wirst du automatisch abgemeldet und musst dich neu einloggen.

Sichere vor dem Update unbedingt den Datenbank-Dump in einem separaten Ordner. Starte danach das Update-Skript und prüfe im Anschluss die Logdatei auf Fehler. Erst wenn keine Warnungen mehr erscheinen, darfst du den Dienst wieder aktivieren.
Denk bitte daran, die Rechnung bis Freitag einzureichen, sonst können wir sie in diesem Monat nicht mehr verbuchen. Trage die Ausgaben außerdem gleich in die gemeinsame Tabelle ein.
Könntest du bitte kurz über meinen Entwurf schauen und mir bis morgen Mittag deine Anmerkungen schicken? Es eilt nicht, aber ich würde den Text gern vor der Besprechung finalisieren.
Für die Teilnahme am Workshop musst du dich bis zum 15. September anmelden. Bitte gib dabei an, ob du online oder vor Ort teilnimmst. Nach der Anmeldung erhältst du eine Bestätigung per E-Mail.
Wenn du einen neuen Beitrag erstellst, wähle bitte das passende Unterforum und füge eine aussagekräftige Überschrift hinzu. Vermeide doppelte Themen, indem du vorher die Suchfunktion nutzt.
Erhitze das Öl in einer Pfanne und brate die Zwiebeln glasig an. Gib dann die Tomaten hinzu und lass alles etwa zehn Minuten köcheln. Zum Schluss mit Salz und Pfeffer abschmecken.

Lade das Installationspaket von der offiziellen Seite herunter und prüfe die Prüfsumme. Führe die Datei als Administrator aus und folge den Anweisungen im Setup-Assistenten. Nach der Installation starte den Rechner neu.
Bitte trage dich in die Urlaubsliste ein, bevor du deinen Antrag abschickst. Der Antrag muss von deiner Teamleitung genehmigt werden. Reiche ihn spätestens vier Wochen vor Urlaubsbeginn ein.

Bereite bitte eine kurze Agenda vor und schicke sie einen Tag vorher an alle Teilnehmer. Notiere während des Meetings die wichtigsten Entscheidungen. Lade die Notizen anschließend im gemeinsamen Ordner hoch.
Beachte, dass Rückgaben nur innerhalb von 30 Tagen möglich sind. Bewahre den Kaufbeleg auf und kontaktiere unseren Support, bevor du das Paket zurücksendest.
To set up offline listening, open Settings, tap Downloads, and choose your preferred audio quality. Keep the app open until your first playlist finishes downloading.
If your Bluetooth speaker isn't appearing, turn it off and on again, then refresh the device list in the app. Make sure the phone and speaker are within 10 feet.
Team, please add your curated tracks to the shared "Q3 Launch" playlist by Friday at noon. Use the comment field to note any clean versions.
To transfer your library from another service, go to Account > Import Music and follow the on-screen steps. You can review matched songs before confirming.
Reminder: Family plan members should update their payment method before the renewal date. Only the plan manager can change billing details.
For best sound on headphones, enable Normalization in Playback settings and set the equalizer to Flat. You can adjust these anytime.
When creating a collaborative playlist, tap Invite and share the link with your friends. Guests can add songs but cannot delete the playlist.
Please submit your podcast episode drafts to the production folder by Wednesday. Include show notes and a final audio file at 192 kbps or higher.
To cancel a subscription, open Account, select Subscription, and choose Cancel Plan. Your access continues until the end of the billing period.
Hey team, can you review the new artist bio before we publish it? Leave comments in the doc and flag any factual issues.
If a song skips repeatedly, clear the app cache and restart your device. Contact support if the issue continues after two attempts.
For the listening party, queue the album in order and turn crossfade off. Ask guests to join the session using the code on screen.
新员工入职第一天请先到行政部领取门禁卡，然后在系统里完成账号激活。设备领用表填写完成后交给直属主管签字。
报销流程：登录财务系统上传发票，选择对应项目编号，提交后等待部门负责人审批。纸质单据请于每周五下午统一交到财务室。
客户回访提醒：请在发货后第三天致电客户确认收货情况，并记录反馈。如客户未接听，请隔天再联系一次。
仓库盘点步骤：先冻结库存，再按货架顺序清点，差异项需拍照并备注原因。盘点结束后由仓管员复核签字。
请各部门在本月25日前更新供应商联系人信息，逾期未更新的记录将默认沿用旧数据。更新时请核对电话和邮箱。
会议室使用须知：预约后请提前十分钟到场，离开前关闭投影和空调。如需取消，请在系统中至少提前两小时操作。
培训安排：周三下午三点进行新系统操作培训，请参训同事带上笔记本电脑并提前安装好客户端。培训结束后需完成一份小测。
数据处理规范：导出表格后请先检查日期格式和金额列，确认无误再上传到共享盘。涉及客户手机号的字段需脱敏保存。
张老师您好，麻烦您把上周的课时统计表补充完整，重点核对缺勤记录。完成后回复我一下，谢谢。
合同归档要求：签署版扫描件命名格式为“客户名称_合同编号_日期”，并放入对应年度文件夹。原件请交法务部保管。
安全提醒：离开工位时请锁屏，重要文件不要放在桌面。发现陌生邮件附件请先联系 IT 支持确认，不要直接打开。
采购申请审批规则：单笔金额超过五千元需附比价说明，超过两万元需由分管副总审批。请申请人在备注栏写明预算来源。
Shared folder Team Docs mein pehle apna naam aur department update karein. Phir Access Request form bharein. Approval ke baad hi edit permission milegi.
Naya document upload karne se pehle file name mein date aur version likhein. Upload ke baad Review folder mein copy rakhein.
Har Friday ko purani files ko Archive folder mein move karein. Delete karne se pehle backup check karna zaroori hai.
Yaad rahe ke client reports sirf Confidential folder mein rakhein. Sharing link kisi bahar wale ke saath share na karein.
Ali bhai, please Budget_2025 file ka latest version upload kar dein. Main usi ko meeting mein use karunga.
Is folder ka use sirf internal team ke liye hai. Files ko rename karne se pehle owner se pooch lein.
Account setup ke liye pehle email verify karein. Uske baad profile picture aur contact number add karein.
Deleted file wapas chahiye ho to Recycle Bin kholen. Restore par click karein aur 24 ghante ke andar confirm karein.
Meeting notes ke aakhir mein action items likhein. Har item ke saath owner aur due date zaroor mention karein.
File names mein spaces ki jagah underscore use karein. Misal: Project_Report_v2.pdf.
Invoice upload karne ke baad accounts team ko notify karein. Payment release sirf manager approval ke baad hoga.
Purani screenshots Misc folder mein na rakhein. Unhe monthly clean-up ke din delete kar dein.

Pour créer un lien de visioconférence, ouvrez les paramètres de l'événement, activez « Ajouter une conférence » puis choisissez votre plateforme. Vérifiez ensuite que les participants invités ont bien reçu le lien.

Merci de confirmer votre présence avant vendredi midi afin que nous puissions réserver la salle. Si vous avez besoin d'un créneau supplémentaire, proposez deux horaires alternatifs dans le fil de discussion.
Procédure d'annulation : sélectionnez la réunion dans l'agenda, cliquez sur « Supprimer », puis cochez l'option d'envoi d'une notification aux participants.
Rappel : les salles du 2e étage sont indisponibles mardi matin. Déplacez les réunions concernées au 3e étage ou passez en visioconférence.
Pour comparer les options de créneau, affichez les disponibilités de l'équipe dans la vue semaine, puis filtrez sur les heures ouvrées. Notez les créneaux où tout le monde est libre.
Merci d'ajouter l'ordre du jour dans la description au moins 24 heures avant la réunion. Les documents joints doivent être accessibles aux participants.
Étape 1 : ouvrez le calendrier partagé. Étape 2 : cliquez sur « Nouvel événement ». Étape 3 : renseignez la date, l'heure et les invités, puis enregistrez.
Si la réunion est récurrente, cochez « Répéter » et choisissez la fréquence hebdomadaire. Pour modifier une seule occurrence, sélectionnez « Cette occurrence uniquement ».
Pouvez-vous envoyer l'invitation avec un accusé de réception obligatoire ? Nous devons savoir rapidement qui participera à la réunion de lancement.
Les participants en distanciel doivent tester leur microphone cinq minutes avant le début. L'hôte peut ouvrir la salle d'attente depuis les paramètres de la réunion.
Conditions d'utilisation : les réservations de salle sont limitées à deux heures. Pour prolonger, créez une nouvelle réservation si le créneau suivant est libre.
Merci de noter que le compte rendu doit être partagé dans les 48 heures. Indiquez clairement les décisions prises et les prochaines actions.

To schedule a recurring team sync, open the calendar, select New Meeting, choose Repeat weekly, and invite the attendees. Set the duration to 30 minutes and add the agenda to the description before sending.
Reminder: Please update your availability for next week by Friday so the planning team can finalize the meeting slots. If you have conflicts, mark them as busy and add a short note.
Meeting room procedure: Arrive five minutes early, connect the HDMI cable to the display, and join the video call from the room console. If the room is locked, contact reception for access.
Polite request: Could you move our 1:1 from Tuesday at 10:00 to Wednesday at 14:00? I have a conflicting client call and want to keep the full hour.
Before accepting a meeting invite, check the time zone shown in the event. If it looks wrong, use the time zone selector and confirm with the organizer before replying.

Terms for shared calendars: Team members may add events to the group calendar, but they must include a title, location, and contact owner. Events without an owner may be removed during weekly cleanup.
How to cancel a meeting: Open the event, choose Cancel Meeting, add a brief reason, and notify attendees. If the meeting is recurring, select whether to cancel this occurrence or the entire series.
Please book the small conference room for the candidate interviews on Thursday. Add each interviewer as an attendee and include the candidate's first name only in the event title.
Setup steps for hybrid meetings: Start the room video system, select Join with meeting ID, and test the microphone. Share the meeting link in the event description for remote attendees.
Calendar hygiene reminder: Decline invites that you do not need to attend and remove old recurring events that are no longer active. This keeps team availability accurate.
For all-hands planning, submit agenda items by Monday noon. The meeting owner will review requests and publish the final agenda in the event notes by end of day.
If a meeting time no longer works, propose a new time in the event comments and wait for the organizer to confirm. Do not change the calendar event directly unless you are the organizer.
选课系统开放时间为本周一至周五每天9:00至17:00。学生需先完成培养方案核对，再在系统中提交选课申请。逾期系统将自动关闭，请合理安排时间。
实验课前请提前阅读安全手册，并穿戴实验服和护目镜。进入实验室后先检查设备状态，如发现异常请立即告知助教。实验结束后请清理台面并关闭电源。
课程作业请于每周五23:59前上传至教学平台。文件命名格式为“学号_姓名_作业编号”。迟交作业将按课程规定扣分，如有特殊情况请提前联系任课教师。
小组项目需要在本周内确定组长和分工。组长负责汇总进度并在下周一前提交开题表。组员请按时完成各自部分，并在例会前更新任务状态。
请任课教师在课程页面补充期末考试形式与允许携带的材料。学生如对考试安排有疑问，可在课程论坛的“考试咨询”版块留言。
预约机房上机练习请至少提前一天在服务页面登记。每次预约时长不超过两小时，如需取消请在上课前半小时操作。未按时签到者名额将释放给其他同学。
课程论坛仅用于讨论课程内容与学习问题。发帖前请先搜索是否已有相同主题，提问时请附上题号和已尝试的思路。请勿发布与课程无关的广告或个人信息。
学生因病无法参加课堂展示，请按学院规定提交请假材料并抄送助教。补展示时间需与任课教师协商确定。未经批准缺席将影响平时成绩。
图书馆课程参考书已移至三楼短期借阅区。每人每次限借两册，借期七天，可续借一次。请按时归还，以免影响其他同学使用。
本周四的讲座地点由A101调整至B203，时间不变。请已报名的同学提前十分钟入场，并携带校园卡签到。座位有限，先到先得。
课程助教每周二和周四下午在办公室提供答疑。请先在共享文档中填写问题编号，以便安排顺序。若需线上答疑，请提前发送会议申请。
学期末课程评价系统已开放，请同学们在两周内完成匿名评价。评价内容仅用于教学改进，不会影响成绩。如遇登录问题，请联系教务处服务台。
Before exporting, review the 'Data Mapping' tab and confirm all required fields are matched. If a column is unmapped, the export will fail validation. Contact support if you need help.
Please send the finalized spreadsheet to the finance team by Thursday so we can reconcile the quarterly numbers. Use the shared drive link in the header row.
To reset your export password, click 'Forgot password' on the login screen and follow the email link. Passwords must be at least 12 characters.
Reminder: The export service will be down for maintenance on Saturday from 2–4 AM UTC. Schedule your downloads before then to avoid interruptions.
If the file contains more than 50,000 rows, split the export into smaller batches. The service caps each file at 10 MB. Refer to the troubleshooting guide for batch settings.
Hi team, please make sure the 'Region' column uses the standard two-letter codes before exporting. The downstream system rejects any other format. Thanks!
You must accept the terms of service before downloading the export. The terms explain how we handle data retention and access logs.
When you receive the export link, copy it into the 'Shared Links' sheet and set an expiration date. Do not forward the link outside the organization.
To add a new export template, go to Settings > Templates > New. Name the template and select the columns you want included. Save your changes.
The 'Export Summary' email includes a checksum; compare it with the file properties. If they don't match, request a new export. This helps ensure data integrity.

To set up your patient portal account, click the activation link in your welcome email, create a password with at least 12 characters, and confirm your date of birth. If you do not receive the email within 15 minutes, check your spam folder before contacting the clinic help desk.
Please complete the pre-visit questionnaire at least 24 hours before your appointment. You can find it under "Forms" in the portal, and your answers will be sent directly to your care team.

To request a prescription refill, open the "Medications" tab, select the medication, and confirm your preferred pharmacy. Refill requests are reviewed within two business days; please contact your provider if you have fewer than five days of medication left.
Reminder: Bring a photo ID and your insurance card to your first in-person visit. Arrive 10 minutes early so the front desk can verify your information.
If you need to reschedule, please cancel or change your appointment at least 24 hours in advance through the "Appointments" section. This helps us offer the time to another patient.
For telehealth visits, test your camera and microphone before joining the waiting room. Please sit in a private, well-lit space and have your medication list available.

Colleagues: please update patient contact notes after each phone call and mark the message as resolved in the portal. If a patient reports an urgent symptom, follow the triage protocol and notify the on-call clinician.
To view lab results, sign in and go to "Test Results." Please allow up to 72 hours for results to be released; your provider may add comments before they become visible.
When sending a secure message, include your full name, date of birth, and the reason for your request. Do not include sensitive information in the subject line.
Please review the financial responsibility section before your appointment and update your payment method if needed. You can pay outstanding balances under "Billing" in the portal.

To grant a family member access to your portal, go to "Account Settings," choose "Authorized Representatives," and complete the consent form. The person will receive an email invitation once you submit the form.

Staff reminder: please verify the patient's identity using two identifiers before discussing protected health information. Document the verification in the portal note and end the call if identity cannot be confirmed.

To compare the Digital and Print+Digital plans, open the Subscribe page and select 'Compare plans.' The table lists monthly price, delivery frequency, and access to the archive. If you need a receipt for reimbursement, choose 'Email receipt' before checkout.

Newsroom reminder: before publishing a correction, add the original timestamp and a short note in the Corrections log. Editors should review the note within one business day. If the error affects a headline, update the social preview as well.

Setting up your morning briefing: go to Account > Newsletters, tick 'Morning Briefing,' and choose your delivery time. You can pause delivery for up to two weeks from the same page. Contact support if the email does not arrive by 7 a.m. local time.

For colleagues coordinating the election-night live blog: please add your name and shift to the shared spreadsheet by Thursday. Use the 'Handoff notes' tab when you finish a shift. If you spot a broken link, flag it in the #liveblog channel rather than editing the published post.

How to download the news app: search for 'The Daily Ledger' in your app store, install it, and open the Settings menu. Turn on 'Background refresh' if you want alerts for breaking stories. The app is free to download, but full article access requires a subscription.

Comment moderation guide: Review reported comments within 24 hours and remove any that include personal contact details. If a comment is borderline, leave it hidden and add a moderator note. Reply to the reporter with the action taken so they can follow up.

To share an article with a colleague, click the share icon and choose 'Copy link.' Paste the link into your message and add a note about why it matters. If the article is subscriber-only, use the 'Gift article' option instead of copying the full text.

Advertising team request: please upload final creative files to the campaign folder by Monday at noon. Name files with the client code and placement size. If a file is missing, email the production desk before the deadline.

Newsletter preferences: You can choose which topics appear in your weekly digest by visiting the Preferences page. Select up to five topics and click Save. To stop all marketing emails, uncheck 'Partner offers' while keeping your news alerts active.

For anyone testing the new search feature: run the same query in the old and new versions, then record the top five results in the comparison sheet. Note any missing filters or slow load times. Send screenshots to the product team by Friday.

Privacy notice update: please review the revised section on cookies and confirm whether your team needs any changes. Comments are due by the end of the month. If no feedback is received, we will publish the update as drafted.
To complete your booking, select the departure date, choose a fare class, and enter each passenger's full name as it appears on their passport. Review the summary before clicking Pay now.
Colleagues: please add the corporate discount code to the booking notes before issuing the ticket. If the code is missing, finance cannot reconcile the invoice.
Setup: connect your agency account to the booking portal, enable two-factor authentication, and import your traveler profiles. Then run a test reservation in the sandbox.
How to change a flight: open Manage Booking, select the itinerary, choose Change flight, and confirm the fare difference. Changes are subject to airline rules.
Please send the hotel voucher to the guest's email address after payment clears. Keep a copy in the reservation record for audit purposes.
For group bookings of ten or more passengers, submit the request form and wait for a coordinator to confirm availability. Do not issue individual tickets before group approval.
Terms: passengers should arrive at the airport at least two hours before domestic departures and three hours before international departures. Follow airline guidance if it differs.
Before travel, download the mobile boarding passes and save them to your wallet. If your phone battery may run low, print a paper copy as a backup.
Travelers with special assistance requests should contact the service desk at least 48 hours before departure so the airline can arrange airport support.
New volunteer orientation is Saturday at 10 a.m. Please arrive 15 minutes early and check in at the front desk. Bring a photo ID and wear closed-toe shoes.
To reset your community portal password, open Settings, choose Security, and tap Reset Password. Follow the email link within 30 minutes.
Reminder for tomorrow’s potluck: label dishes with allergens and bring serving utensils. We’ll start serving at noon in the courtyard.
Team, please review the draft agenda before Thursday’s call and add comments by Wednesday at 5 p.m. If you can’t make it, send your updates to me.
How to join the live stream: click the event link, enter your name, and wait in the lobby. The session starts promptly at 7 p.m. ET.
For the beach cleanup, meet at the north parking lot at 8 a.m. Wear sturdy shoes and bring a reusable water bottle. Gloves and bags will be provided.
Contest rules: post one photo with #SpringMarket, tag a friend in the comments, and submit by April 30. Only one entry per account.
Please keep the stairwell clear during the move. Use the freight elevator for boxes and label each item with your apartment number.
Workshop prep: install the software before class, create a free account, and test your microphone. Join the waiting room five minutes early.
Neighbors, please move bins to the curb after 6 p.m. and bring them in by Wednesday morning. Keep the sidewalk accessible for strollers.
Application checklist: complete the form, attach two references, and email everything to volunteer@example.org by Friday. Late submissions may not be reviewed.
To set up account alerts, open Settings > Notifications, choose the alert type, and tap Save. You can update these preferences at any time.
Please review the attached fee schedule before our call and note any differences between the Standard and Plus accounts. If something is unclear, reply with the specific line item.
When comparing savings options, check the minimum opening deposit and monthly fee first, then review the interest tier details. The comparison view lets you select up to three products at once.
For a joint account application, both applicants must complete identity verification. Upload a valid ID and proof of address for each person before submitting.
Reminder: scheduled transfers created before 4:00 PM ET will process the same business day. Transfers created after that time will process on the next business day.
To reset your online banking password, tap Forgot password on the sign-in screen, enter your username, and follow the verification steps sent to your registered email.
Please confirm whether you want paper statements or e-statements for the new checking account. You can change this preference later under Profile > Statements.
If you are comparing mortgage options, review the APR, origination fee, and rate-lock period for each offer. Use the estimate calculator to see monthly payments at different loan terms.
Before enabling international transactions on your card, check the travel notice section and confirm the countries and dates. This helps reduce the chance of a temporary block.
To link an external account, select Add account, choose your bank, and verify the two small deposits. Linking usually takes one to two business days.
Team: please update the comparison spreadsheet with the latest APY figures by Thursday. Include the source date for each rate so we can confirm accuracy.
For business checking comparisons, review the monthly transaction limit and cash deposit fee, then select the account that matches your expected volume. You can save the comparison as a PDF.

To complete your pre-visit check-in, sign in to the portal and open the Appointments tab. Select your upcoming visit, review your medications, and confirm your preferred pharmacy. Submit the form at least 24 hours before your appointment.

New patients should upload a photo ID and insurance card under Profile > Documents. Once uploaded, call the front desk to verify that your records are linked correctly. Please allow one business day for processing.

If you need a medication refill, submit a request through the Prescriptions page and include the pharmacy phone number. Requests received after 3 p.m. will be reviewed the next business day. Do not stop taking prescribed medication without speaking to your clinician.

Reminder: fasting labs are scheduled in the morning. Please drink water as usual, take medications unless told otherwise, and arrive 15 minutes early for check-in. Bring your photo ID and insurance card.

Colleagues: before closing the clinic, confirm that all voicemails have been returned and the secure fax inbox has been checked. Place unsigned forms in the provider review bin and lock the medication room. Thank you for keeping handoff smooth.

To join a telehealth visit, open the appointment in the portal and click Join Video Visit five minutes before the start time. Test your camera and microphone, then wait in the virtual lobby. If you are disconnected, return to the appointment page and rejoin.

Please complete the patient satisfaction survey after your visit. Your responses help us improve scheduling and communication. The survey takes about three minutes, and you can skip any question you prefer not to answer.

For billing questions, review the Statements section and select the invoice in question. Add a note describing the charge you are asking about and upload any supporting documents. Our billing team will respond within five business days.

Staff procedure for urgent calls: ask for the patient’s name, date of birth, and callback number, then route the call to the triage nurse. Do not provide clinical advice before triage review. Document the call in the patient’s chart.

To request an appointment, choose a provider and preferred date range on the Scheduling page. Add a brief reason for the visit and indicate whether you prefer in-person or virtual care. The clinic will confirm by portal message or phone.

Please update your contact information before your next visit. Go to Account Settings, edit your phone number and address, and save changes. Accurate contact details help us send appointment reminders and lab results.

Team reminder: review tomorrow’s schedule for patients who need interpreters or accessibility accommodations. Send a portal message to the front desk with any changes by 4 p.m. today so arrangements can be confirmed.

To complete your booking, enter the passenger's full name exactly as it appears on their passport. Then select the preferred seat and confirm the payment method. If you need help, contact our support team.

Please review the cancellation policy before confirming your reservation. Cancellations made within 24 hours of departure may incur a fee. To cancel, open your booking and select 'Manage reservation'.
Colleagues: please submit all travel receipts within five working days of returning from your trip. Attach them to the expense report and send it to the finance team for approval.
Check-in opens 48 hours before your flight. Go to the airline's website, enter your booking reference, and download your boarding pass. Arrive at the airport at least two hours before departure.
To add checked baggage, log in to your account and open the booking details. Choose the number of bags and pay any additional fees. Baggage must be added at least four hours before departure.
Reminder: verify that each passenger's passport is valid for at least six months after the return date. If it is not, update the traveler details before we issue the tickets.

For group bookings of ten or more passengers, please send the passenger list to our group desk. We will confirm availability and provide a quote within two business days. Do not issue individual tickets until the quote is approved.

If your flight is delayed by more than three hours, you may request a refund or rebooking. Contact our support team with your booking number and preferred alternative. Keep all receipts for any necessary meals or accommodation.
To request an invoice, go to 'Billing' in your account and select the booking. Enter your company details and click 'Generate invoice'. The invoice will be emailed to you within 24 hours.

Users may not scrape forecast data or redistribute alerts without written permission. Contact the data team to request a commercial license.

Please review the attached station maintenance checklist before your shift. Report any damaged anemometer cups or blocked rain gauges to the facilities coordinator.

Los trabajos se entregan en el aula virtual en formato PDF. Nombre el archivo con su apellido y el número de la tarea. La fecha límite es el 15 de mayo a las 23:59.

Para solicitar una prórroga, envíe un correo al profesor antes de la fecha de entrega. Explique brevemente el motivo y adjunte la documentación disponible. La solicitud no garantiza la aprobación.

Recuerde revisar el calendario de exámenes publicado en la página del curso. Llegue al aula con su carné universitario y sin dispositivos electrónicos. Cualquier cambio se anunciará con al menos 48 horas de antelación.

Um den Teig zuzubereiten, vermengen Sie zunächst Mehl, Zucker und Butter in einer großen Schüssel. Kneten Sie die Zutaten anschließend etwa fünf Minuten lang, bis ein glatter Teig entsteht. Lassen Sie ihn danach 30 Minuten im Kühlschrank ruhen.

Bitte rühren Sie die Soße ständig um, damit sie nicht anbrennt. Sollte sie zu dick werden, geben Sie etwas Wasser hinzu. Zum Schluss mit Salz und Pfeffer abschmecken.
So funktioniert's: Klicken Sie auf 'Rezept speichern', um es in Ihrer Sammlung abzulegen. Anschließend können Sie die Zutatenliste direkt auf Ihre Einkaufsliste übertragen.
Achten Sie darauf, das Gemüse nicht zu lange zu garen, damit es noch Biss hat. Geben Sie es erst in den letzten fünf Minuten in die Pfanne.
Für das Topping: Rösten Sie die Mandelblättchen in einer Pfanne ohne Fett goldbraun. Streuen Sie sie vor dem Servieren über den Kuchen.
Bitte denken Sie daran, das Rezept nach dem Testen zu bewerten. Ihre Rückmeldung hilft uns, die Anleitungen verständlicher zu machen.
Wichtig: Lassen Sie das Fleisch nach dem Braten kurz ruhen, bevor Sie es aufschneiden. So bleiben die Säfte erhalten und es wird besonders saftig.
Kleine Erinnerung: Vergessen Sie nicht, den Backofen rechtzeitig auszuschalten. Das Gebäck sollte nach dem Backen noch zehn Minuten im ausgeschalteten Ofen nachziehen.

To enable severe weather alerts, open Settings > Notifications, turn on 'Emergency Alerts,' and allow location access. Confirm the test notification appears within five minutes. If it does not, restart the app and check your device's notification permissions.
To export a forecast history, select the date range on the Reports page and choose CSV. Keep the file under 50 MB; if it is larger, split the range into monthly intervals.

Before publishing a thunderstorm warning, verify the radar timestamp and confirm the affected counties in the draft. Attach the latest model run to the incident log, then submit for supervisor approval.
Remember to switch the station display to local time at the start of each shift. The overnight team should also check the backup anemometer reading every four hours.
Could you update the rainfall totals for the north basin before the 3 p.m. briefing? Please add a note if any gauge is still reporting stale data.
Users must not resell API forecast data without written permission. If rate limits are exceeded, the client should back off and retry after the interval shown in the response headers.
Select a location to view current conditions. If no location is selected, the dashboard will default to the last saved city.
During the scheduled maintenance window, please do not upload new station configurations. Existing forecasts will remain available, but edits will fail until the service returns.
If you hear the outdoor siren during a lightning test, check the schedule before calling dispatch. Report any siren that fails to sound within ten minutes of the scheduled test.
When a sensor reading is missing, mark the station as incomplete rather than entering zero. Review the gap in the daily quality report and notify the data team if it persists for more than two hours.
New forecasters should complete the radar interpretation module before their first solo shift. Use the practice workspace to run at least three sample warnings and ask a mentor to review the results.
To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the emailed link. If the link expires, request a new one; do not share the link with anyone.
Para activar la verificación en dos pasos, entra en Ajustes > Seguridad y marca la opción. Luego confirma con el código que recibirás por SMS. No compartas ese código con nadie.
Calienta el aceite a fuego medio y añade la cebolla picada. Remueve durante cinco minutos antes de incorporar el tomate. Sirve caliente y añade sal al gusto.
Recuerden que la reunión del equipo se movió a las 10:00. Por favor, revisen el documento compartido antes de conectarse. Si no pueden asistir, avisen en el chat.
¿Podrían enviarme las cifras actualizadas antes del viernes? Necesito incluirlas en el informe mensual. Gracias por la ayuda.
Para participar, publica una foto con el hashtag #MiCiudad y etiqueta a dos amigos. El plazo termina el 30 de junio. Solo se aceptará una participación por persona.
Descarga la aplicación y crea una cuenta con tu correo. Después elige tus intereses y activa las notificaciones. Puedes cambiar estas preferencias cuando quieras.
Al publicar, evita compartir datos personales como direcciones o teléfonos. Si ves un comentario ofensivo, usa el botón de reportar. Nuestro equipo lo revisará en 24 horas.
Haz tres series de diez sentadillas, descansando un minuto entre cada una. Mantén la espalda recta y las rodillas alineadas con los pies. Si sientes dolor, detente.
Llega al aeropuerto dos horas antes de tu vuelo. Lleva tu documento de identidad y la tarjeta de embarque. Una vez en la puerta, espera a que llamen tu grupo.
No olvides pagar la factura de la luz antes del día 15. Puedes hacerlo desde la app o en el banco. Si ya pagaste, ignora este mensaje.
Llena la maceta con tierra abonada y haz un pequeño hoyo. Coloca la semilla y cúbrela sin apretar. Riega cada dos días y ponla cerca de la ventana.
Chicos, ¿pueden confirmar quiénes vienen a la cena del sábado? Necesito reservar la mesa. Por favor, respondan antes del jueves.

To start a return, open your order history and select Return or replace items. Choose the reason, print the prepaid label, and drop the package at an authorized carrier. Refunds are issued within 5 business days after we receive the item.
Please confirm your shipping address before 2 p.m. on the dispatch date. If you need to make a change after that, contact Customer Care and we will do our best to update the carrier details.
Reminder: add your apartment or unit number to the delivery address. Orders missing this information may be held by the carrier until the address is confirmed.

Hi Sam, please approve the replacement shipment for order #48291 and mark the original item as damaged in the portal. The customer has already uploaded photos, so no further action is needed from them.
When contacting support about a payment issue, include your order number and the last four digits of the card used. Do not send full card numbers by email.
To redeem a gift card, enter the code at checkout and select Apply. The balance can be combined with one promotional discount per order.
If your package shows as delivered but you cannot find it, check with neighbors and your building's mailroom first. Then contact us within 48 hours so we can open a carrier investigation.
Please leave the parcel with the front desk if no one answers. If the front desk is closed, return it to the local depot and leave a delivery notice.
Sellers must upload tracking information within two business days of marking an order as shipped. Buyers can request a refund if tracking is not added within seven days.
For exchanges, place a new order for the desired size and return the original item separately. This ensures the item is reserved while your return is being processed.
Reminder to the fulfillment team: scan each item before packing and include the packing slip in the box. Flag any order with a missing item before the carrier pickup at 4 p.m.
You can update your marketing preferences at any time by going to Account Settings and selecting Communication Preferences. Changes usually take effect within 24 hours.

Bitte laden Sie für jede Immobilie mindestens fünf Fotos hoch, davon eines von der Fassade. Achten Sie darauf, dass keine personenbezogenen Daten wie Kfz-Kennzeichen zu sehen sind. Die Freigabe erfolgt anschließend durch unser Redaktionsteam.
Um einen Besichtigungstermin anzubieten, öffnen Sie im Objektmenü den Punkt „Termine“ und tragen Sie mindestens zwei Zeitfenster ein. Bestätigte Termine werden automatisch an Interessenten versendet.
Bitte prüfen Sie vor Veröffentlichung die Angaben zu Wohnfläche, Zimmerzahl und Baujahr. Korrekturen können Sie bis zur Freigabe jederzeit im Entwurf vornehmen.
Fügen Sie dem Exposé bitte den Energieausweis als PDF bei. Falls dieser noch nicht vorliegt, markieren Sie das Objekt als „in Vorbereitung“ und reichen Sie das Dokument innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach.
Für Rückfragen zu einem Inserat wenden Sie sich bitte an das zuständige Maklerbüro. Die Kontaktdaten finden Sie rechts oben auf der Objektseite.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass Änderungen an der Kaltmiete erst nach Rücksprache mit dem Eigentümer veröffentlicht werden dürfen. Dokumentieren Sie die Freigabe im internen Notizfeld.

Möchten Sie ein Objekt als „reserviert“ kennzeichnen, setzen Sie den entsprechenden Status im Dashboard. Bitte informieren Sie danach kurz das Serviceteam, damit die Interessentenliste angepasst wird.
Laden Sie Grundrisse möglichst als gut lesbare PDF-Datei hoch und benennen Sie die Datei nach Objektnummer. So können wir die Unterlagen schneller zuordnen.
Bitte senden Sie uns die unterschriebene Vollmacht bis Freitag zurück. Ohne diese Unterlage kann das Inserat nicht freigeschaltet werden.
Bei der Texterstellung bitte keine Abkürzungen wie „Zi.“ oder „qm“ verwenden; schreiben Sie die Begriffe aus. So bleiben die Exposés einheitlich und besser lesbar.
Prüfen Sie regelmäßig den Posteingang im Eigentümerportal. Neue Anfragen sollten innerhalb von zwei Werktagen beantwortet werden.
Um die Sichtbarkeit zu erhöhen, können Sie ein Inserat mit dem Merkmal „Top-Angebot“ versehen. Bitte stimmen Sie diese Option vorher mit dem Verkäufer ab.

Pour installer le client, ouvrez un terminal et exécutez la commande d’installation. Redémarrez le service après l’installation. Vérifiez ensuite que la version affichée correspond à celle indiquée dans les notes de version.

Si vous avez perdu votre mot de passe, cliquez sur « Mot de passe oublié » sur la page de connexion. Saisissez l’adresse associée à votre compte, puis suivez le lien reçu par courriel. Le lien expire au bout de trente minutes.

Avant toute mise à jour, effectuez une sauvegarde complète de la base de données. Conservez l’archive dans un emplacement distinct du serveur applicatif. Notez la date et la version dans le journal d’exploitation.

Rappel : les jetons d’API doivent être renouvelés tous les quatre-vingt-dix jours. Pensez à mettre à jour les variables d’environnement après chaque renouvellement. Ne partagez jamais un jeton dans un ticket public.

Bonjour, peux-tu relire la section « Configuration réseau » avant la publication de vendredi ? J’ai ajouté les captures d’écran manquantes et corrigé les exemples de commandes. Merci de signaler les incohérences directement dans le document partagé.

Lors d’un incident de niveau critique, ouvrez immédiatement un canal dédié et informez l’équipe d’astreinte. Ne modifiez pas la configuration de production sans validation d’un responsable technique. Consignez chaque action dans le compte rendu d’incident.

Dans l’onglet « Authentification », activez l’option SSO et renseignez l’URL du fournisseur d’identité. Téléchargez le certificat de signature, puis importez-le dans la console d’administration. Testez la connexion avec un compte de test avant d’activer le mode obligatoire.

Pour exporter les données, sélectionnez la période souhaitée et choisissez le format CSV. Lancez l’export, puis attendez la notification de fin de traitement. Le fichier reste disponible pendant sept jours dans l’espace de téléchargement.
Une maintenance planifiée aura lieu mardi entre 22 h et 23 h. Pendant cette fenêtre, les connexions à l’API seront temporairement indisponibles. Veuillez planifier vos traitements en conséquence.

Merci de joindre le journal des erreurs et la version du logiciel à votre demande. Ces informations nous permettent de reproduire le problème plus rapidement. Si possible, précisez également le système d’exploitation utilisé.
Accédez à « Gestion des utilisateurs », puis ouvrez la fiche du collaborateur concerné. Attribuez le rôle « Éditeur » et enregistrez les modifications. L’accès prend effet à la prochaine connexion.

Lorsqu’un compte est supprimé, les données personnelles associées sont effacées sous trente jours. Les journaux d’audit sont conservés plus longtemps pour des raisons de sécurité. Contactez le délégué à la protection des données pour toute demande spécifique.
To set up your calendar, open Settings > Calendars, choose your time zone, and click Save. You can then add colleagues by selecting Share and entering their email addresses.
Please review the agenda before the meeting and add any discussion items to the shared doc by Thursday. If you can't attend, assign a delegate in the event response.
When booking a meeting room, select the room from the resource list and confirm the capacity matches your attendee count. Rooms with video conferencing are marked with a camera icon.
Reminder: Q3 planning sessions must be scheduled before the end of next week. Use the team calendar to find a slot that works for all core attendees.

To reschedule an event, open it from your calendar, choose Edit, update the date or time, and send the update to attendees. Recurring meetings may require changing only this event or the entire series.
If you're joining remotely, use the video link in the calendar invite and test your microphone five minutes before the start. Dial-in details are included for anyone without video.
Team guideline: keep meetings to 45 minutes when possible and include a clear purpose in the invite. Please respond to invitations within two business days.

To compare availability across colleagues, use the Find a Time tab, drag the proposed meeting block, and select the time that shows everyone as free. The scheduler will suggest alternatives if there's a conflict.
Before creating a recurring meeting, confirm the recurrence pattern and end date. If you need to change one occurrence later, open that event and select This event only.
Please complete the meeting feedback form within 24 hours. Your responses help us choose better times and formats for future sessions.
To add a calendar to your mobile device, go to Settings > Accounts > Add Account, select your work account, and enable Calendar sync. Contact IT if you see an authentication error.
Cancellation policy: notify attendees at least 24 hours in advance and include a brief reason. For external meetings, also send an email to the client contact.
Para confirmar tu asistencia, abre la invitación y selecciona 'Aceptar'. Si no puedes asistir, responde con un comentario para que busquemos otra fecha.
Hola, ¿podrías enviarme la agenda de la reunión antes del viernes? Así revisamos los temas con antelación y aprovechamos mejor el tiempo.
Sigue estos pasos para crear una reunión recurrente: entra en Calendario, elige 'Nuevo evento', activa 'Repetir' y define la frecuencia semanal.
Te recordamos que la sesión de planificación se trasladó a las 10:00. Actualiza tu calendario si ya habías aceptado la invitación anterior.
Los participantes deben unirse cinco minutos antes del inicio y silenciar el micrófono durante la presentación. Al final habrá una ronda de preguntas.
Para cambiar la hora de una reunión, el organizador debe abrir el evento, seleccionar 'Editar' y actualizar la franja horaria. El sistema notificará automáticamente a todos los invitados.
La sala 3B está reservada para la sesión de planificación. Trae el portátil y conecta el cable HDMI que encontrarás en la mesa.
Si necesitas una sala más grande, solicita el cambio a través del portal de reservas. Espera la confirmación del administrador antes de avisar al equipo.
Por favor, acepta la invitación al taller de formación antes del martes. Necesitamos saber el aforo para preparar el material.
El enlace de videollamada se activa diez minutos antes. Comprueba tu audio y cámara desde la configuración antes de entrar.
Para cancelar una reunión, abre el evento y selecciona 'Cancelar reunión'. Añade un mensaje breve explicando el motivo para que los asistentes estén informados.
Cuando compartas un calendario con un compañero, elige el permiso de 'ver disponibilidad' o 'editar eventos' según lo que necesite. Puedes cambiarlo más adelante desde la configuración.
Hi Support, I just received my new router. Could you send me the steps to set it up with my account? I want to make sure I connect it before the work call tomorrow.

To reset your password, open the account settings page, choose Security, and select Reset password. You’ll receive an email with a link that expires in 30 minutes. If it doesn’t arrive, please check your spam folder.
Hi Maya, can you please update ticket #48291 with the customer’s new delivery address before end of day? The courier needs it by 4 p.m. Thanks!

Our refund policy says returns must be requested within 30 days of delivery. Once we receive the item, please allow 5–7 business days for the refund to appear. Keep the return tracking number for your records.
Reminder for the support team: all priority-one tickets should be acknowledged within 15 minutes and escalated to the duty manager if there is no response after one hour.
Hello, I need to change the email address on my account. Please let me know what information you need from me to verify my identity before making the change.
To file a warranty claim, attach a photo of the product label and a brief description of the issue. Our team will review the claim and reply with next steps within two business days.
Hi team, when closing a ticket, please add a short summary of the resolution and tag the correct product area. This helps us review recurring issues in the weekly report.
Customer request: Please schedule my installation for any weekday morning after 9 a.m. I will be home and can provide access to the utility closet.
For security, do not share your one-time code with anyone. If you receive a call asking for the code, hang up and contact us using the number on our website.
Before shipping a replacement, please verify that the customer’s address matches the order record. If it does not match, ask the customer to confirm the correct address in writing.
To install the CLI, download the package for your operating system, verify the checksum, and run the installer. After installation, open a new terminal and run `docs --version` to confirm the setup.
Before creating an API token, confirm that your account has the Developer role. Then go to Settings > Access Tokens, select Create token, and store the value in your secret manager.
Please review the draft release notes by Friday and add any missing migration steps to the shared checklist. If you find a breaking change, tag the platform team in the document.
To restore a workspace from backup, open the Admin Console, choose Backups, and select the most recent verified snapshot. Do not cancel the restore job once it starts.
If the documentation build fails, clear the cache with `make clean`, reinstall dependencies, and rebuild the site. Attach the full build log to the support ticket if the error persists.
Reminder: rotate the staging database credentials on the first Monday of each month. Update the CI secrets after rotation and notify the QA channel.
To request access to the analytics dashboard, submit the access form with your team name and manager approval. Access requests are reviewed within two business days.
For billing questions, check the invoice history in the account portal before contacting support. Include the invoice number and workspace ID in your message.
To migrate content from the legacy system, export the source archive, validate the manifest, and import it into the new project. Schedule the migration during the maintenance window.
Before publishing, confirm that all screenshots are up to date and that no internal links point to staging URLs. Then request a final review from the documentation owner.
To set up severe-weather alerts, open Settings > Notifications, choose your location, and enable push alerts. You can add up to five locations on the standard plan.
Please review the rainfall totals in the shared dashboard before the 3 p.m. briefing. If the gauge data looks incomplete, email the data team and note the station ID.
To compare the hourly and daily forecast views, use the toggle at the top of the dashboard. The comparison panel keeps both views side by side for the selected date range.
Before publishing the weekend outlook, confirm that the temperature range matches the latest model run. Update the confidence note if the spread is wider than five degrees.
Reminder: free accounts can export CSV data once per day. For bulk exports, upgrade to the Professional plan or contact support for a temporary limit increase.
When configuring a weather webhook, enter the endpoint URL, select the alert types, and send a test event. A successful test returns a 200 response within ten seconds.
Please add the coastal wind advisory to tomorrow’s bulletin if the gust threshold is still above 35 mph. Check the 6 a.m. update before finalizing the wording.
To change your default units, go to Account > Preferences and select Fahrenheit or Celsius. The change applies to forecasts, alerts, and exported reports.
If you need to compare historical snowfall records, choose two date ranges in the climate explorer and select Compare. The chart will display both series with matching axes.
Terms of use: keep API keys private and rotate them every 90 days. Do not share keys in public repositories or client-side code.
For the vendor comparison, please collect the alert latency, coverage map, and pricing tier for each provider. Send the notes to the procurement channel by Thursday.
To reset a forgotten password, click Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the emailed link. The link expires after 30 minutes.
To reset the router, hold the recessed button for 10 seconds, then wait for the status light to turn solid blue. If it stays red after two minutes, unplug it and try again.
Please post your logs in the shared folder before Friday so the team can review them. Use the naming format projectname_date.log and mention me if anything looks urgent.
When setting up the dev environment, install Node 20 first, then run npm ci from the repo root. Don't commit the .env file; copy .env.example and fill in your local values.
Reminder for tomorrow's maintenance window: save your work by 9:45 PM, and don't start long-running jobs after 9:50. The service should be back by 11:00 PM.
If you're filing a bug report, include the browser version, steps to reproduce, and a screenshot of the error. Please keep one issue per ticket so we can triage faster.
For the community survey, choose the option that best matches your experience and add comments only if you want to explain your answer. Submit by the end of the month.
Can you update the shared calendar with the new meeting time? Please add the dial-in link and mark it as recurring every second Tuesday.
To join the workshop, register with your work email and complete the pre-reading before Tuesday. The organizer will send the Zoom link the day before.
When replying to a for-sale post, include your pickup area and preferred time window. Do not post personal phone numbers in the public thread; use direct messages instead.
Please review the draft agenda and add any items you want covered under 'Other business.' Keep each item to one or two sentences so we can get through everything.
For the photo upload, resize images to 1200px wide and use JPG or PNG. Name files with your username and the date so we can keep them organized.
To compare fares, open the Filters panel and select "Nonstop only." Then sort by total price; baggage fees are shown under each fare.
Please review the cancellation policy before booking. If you need to change dates, use Manage Booking and choose a new departure.
Reminder: enter passenger names exactly as they appear on the passport. Middle names can be added during checkout.
For group bookings of six or more travelers, contact our support team with your preferred dates and destination.
When comparing hotel rates, check whether breakfast and free cancellation are included. Select "View details" to see room-level terms.
If your itinerary includes a connection, confirm the minimum layover time. The airline's requirements are listed under "Trip details."
Colleagues: please update the shared quote sheet before the client call. Add the final fare and any seat selection fees.
Choose the flexible fare if your plans may change; it allows one date change without a fee. Compare the total cost with the saver fare.
Please ensure the billing address matches the cardholder's statement. If it does not, the payment may be declined.
For accessibility requests, add a note at checkout and call the airline at least 48 hours before departure to confirm.
Terms: travelers must check visa and entry requirements for their destination. The booking service does not provide immigration advice.
Pour configurer le logiciel, téléchargez l’archive, décompressez-la dans le dossier racine, puis lancez le script d’installation. N’oubliez pas de redémarrer le service après la mise à jour.
Pour publier une image, cliquez sur l’icône trombone, sélectionnez le fichier et validez. La taille maximale est de 2 Mo.
La procédure de sauvegarde consiste à copier le dossier /data vers le NAS chaque vendredi. Vérifiez ensuite que la tâche planifiée s’est bien exécutée.
Rappel : mercredi prochain, pensez à mettre à jour vos mots de passe avant la maintenance. Le forum sera indisponible de 22 h à minuit.
Peux-tu jeter un œil à mon comparatif des offres d’hébergement avant demain ? Si tu vois des erreurs dans les prix, signale-les-moi en commentaire.
Les participants sont priés de poster leurs questions dans le fil dédié et d’éviter les doublons. Merci de respecter le format demandé dans le premier message.
Pour comparer les options, listez d’abord vos critères (prix, stockage, support), puis notez chaque service sur 5. Gardez une colonne pour les remarques.
Si l’erreur persiste, videz le cache du navigateur, reconnectez-vous et testez en navigation privée. Envoyez ensuite le journal des erreurs à l’équipe support.
Merci de répondre au sondage avant vendredi 17 h. Les résultats seront partagés lundi matin sur ce fil.
Pourriez-vous confirmer la version du logiciel que vous utilisez ? Cela nous aidera à reproduire le problème et à comparer les comportements.
Avant de poster, lisez la charte du forum et vérifiez que votre message contient bien le contexte et les étapes déjà essayées.
At pickup, please inspect the vehicle with a staff member and note any existing damage on the check-out form before driving away. Keep the form in the glovebox and show it at return.
To return the car after hours, park it in bay 12, lock the doors, and drop the keys into the secure box by the office door. Take a photo of the fuel gauge and odometer for your records.

Colleagues: when a customer calls about a late return, first confirm the booking number and current return time, then offer the grace period listed in policy section 4.2. Do not promise a waiver without supervisor approval.
Please refuel the vehicle to the same level shown on the rental agreement before return. If you cannot refuel, the service desk will apply the refueling charge listed in your contract.
If a warning light appears on the dashboard, pull over safely and call roadside assistance at the number on the key tag. Do not continue driving if the oil pressure or temperature light stays on.
Remember to remove all personal belongings from the car before handing back the keys. Check the glovebox, seat pockets, and trunk, as items left behind are held for only 14 days.

To add an additional driver, bring their valid license to the rental desk and complete the authorization form. The added driver must be at least 25 and meet the same insurance requirements as the primary renter.
Please return the vehicle with the interior reasonably clean and free of trash. A cleaning fee may apply if sand, pet hair, or stains require professional cleaning.
When handing over a vehicle between shifts, please log the fuel level, mileage, and any new damage in the handover sheet. Report low fuel or missing keys to the shift supervisor immediately.
For toll charges, keep the transponder mounted on the windshield and do not remove it during the rental. We will bill toll usage to your card within five business days after return.
If you need a child seat, request it at least 24 hours before pickup so we can install and check it. Staff will show you how to adjust the harness before you leave.

Please report any accident or damage to the rental office as soon as possible, even if no other vehicle is involved. Complete the incident report in the glovebox and call the emergency line before arranging repairs.

Pour recevoir notre newsletter hebdomadaire, rendez-vous dans la rubrique « Mon compte » puis activez l’option « Communications ». Sélectionnez les thèmes qui vous intéressent et enregistrez vos préférences. Vous pourrez vous désinscrire à tout moment via le lien présent en bas de chaque e-mail.

Si vous repérez une erreur dans un article, écrivez à correction@exemple.fr en précisant l’URL et le passage concerné. Notre équipe vérifie l’information sous 48 heures ouvrées et publie une correction si nécessaire. Merci de ne pas modifier l’article directement.
Rappel : les commentaires sont modérés avant publication. Merci de rester courtois et de ne pas divulguer d’informations personnelles. Les messages contenant des liens promotionnels seront supprimés.

« Peux-tu relire la brève avant 17 h et me confirmer les chiffres ? » demande la cheffe d’édition à son adjoint. « Si tu vois une incohérence, signale-la dans le fil de discussion plutôt que de corriger directement. »

L’utilisateur s’engage à ne pas reproduire les contenus sans autorisation écrite. Pour toute demande de republication, adressez un courriel à droits@exemple.fr. Les demandes sont traitées sous cinq jours ouvrés.

Téléchargez l’application depuis l’App Store ou Google Play, puis ouvrez-la et acceptez les conditions d’utilisation. Activez les notifications si vous souhaitez être alerté des dernières actualités. La connexion se fait avec les mêmes identifiants que sur le site.

Vous avez atteint votre limite d’articles gratuits pour ce mois. Abonnez-vous pour continuer à lire nos enquêtes, ou reconnectez-vous si vous êtes déjà abonné. Pour toute question, consultez notre FAQ.

Pour signaler un commentaire inapproprié, cliquez sur les trois points à droite du message puis choisissez « Signaler ». Indiquez le motif et validez. Nos modérateurs examinent chaque signalement dans les 24 heures.

« Merci de confirmer votre présence avant vendredi et de préciser si vous avez des restrictions alimentaires », peut-on lire dans l’invitation envoyée aux lecteurs. Les places sont limitées et attribuées par ordre d’arrivée.

Les archives sont accessibles uniquement aux abonnés. Connectez-vous puis utilisez le moteur de recherche par date ou par mot-clé. Pour citer un article, mentionnez la source et la date de publication.
To set up your new account, open Settings > Audio, choose your output device, and tap Test Sound. Then save your preferences before starting a playlist.
Create a collaborative playlist: tap Library, select New Playlist, enable Collaborative, and share the link with your team. Add at least three songs before the Friday meeting.
Reminder: renew the family plan before March 30 so everyone keeps access. Check payment details and confirm the plan in Account > Subscription.
Hi Sam, can you add the new indie releases to the office playlist before lunch? Please keep the explicit tracks out of the shared version.
To download albums for offline listening, go to the album page, tap the download icon, and keep the app open until it finishes. You can check progress under Downloads.
Reset your password from the login screen by choosing Forgot password. Enter your email, follow the link, and update your password within 24 hours.
For the listening party, queue the album in order, set crossfade to zero, and mute notifications. Start playback at 7:00 PM sharp.
Please review the royalty statement in the artist dashboard and flag any missing tracks by Friday. Once verified, approve the payout request.
Pair your speaker by opening Bluetooth settings and selecting the device name. If it doesn't appear, restart the speaker and try again.
When creating a station, choose a seed artist, adjust the variety slider, and save the station to your library. Use the thumbs up/down buttons to refine recommendations.
Team, update the shared playlist description with the event date and venue. Also remove any duplicate tracks before we publish the link.
To cancel a subscription, go to Account > Plan, select Cancel Plan, and confirm the effective date. You can keep listening until the end of the billing period.
To enable high-quality streaming, open Settings > Audio Quality and select 'Very High.' If you're on mobile data, choose 'Automatic' to avoid using too much data.
You can compare Premium Individual and Duo on the Plans page. Select 'Compare plans' to see pricing, account limits, and offline listening features side by side.

Recuerda que el boletín de montaña se actualiza los viernes a mediodía. Por favor, envía tus observaciones de nieve al equipo de guardia antes del jueves por la tarde. Incluye fotos y altura aproximada si es posible.

Los avisos de niebla se emiten cuando la visibilidad baja de 500 metros. En ese caso, conduce con luces antiniebla y reduce la velocidad. Sigue las indicaciones de la Dirección General de Tráfico y consulta el mapa de carreteras antes de salir.
